blocks.text: HANGS General Contracting LP
Year-end payroll details for 2026
Demonstration document. Not for filing or payment.
Entity: HANGS General Contracting LP
Entity type: Washington limited partnership
EIN: 00-4567890 (demonstration)
Business address: 2150 Harbor Ridge Ave S, Suite 300, Seattle, WA 98134
Tax year: 2026
Kind of payer: 941
Kind of employer: None apply
Establishment number: None
Other EIN used this year: None
Employees paid in 2026: 101 (one Form W-2 each)
Forms W-2 filed for 2025: 104
Pay frequency: Biweekly, 26 regular payrolls; one bonus payroll on June 26, 2026
State: Washington; no state or local income tax is withheld, so boxes 15 to 20 are not used
401(k) plan: Employee elective deferrals by salary reduction; no employer contributions and no designated Roth contributions in 2026
Section 125 plan: Employee health premiums by salary reduction
Employer-sponsored health coverage: Insured group health plan; the employer share of the premiums is in the benefits file, not in these files
Company vehicles: Two pickups assigned to employees and available for personal use; the safety manager keeps the 2026 vehicle use log
Other fringe benefits: None recorded for 2026
Third-party sick pay: None
Overtime: Hourly employees are paid time and a half for hours over 40 in a workweek; salaried employees are exempt and paid no overtime
Washington Paid Leave: Employee premiums are withheld after tax and are included in each employee's wages
Employee copies: Paper Copies B, C and 2 mailed to the home address on the employee roster
Payroll contact: Dana Whitfield, Controller, payroll@hangs-gc.example
Quarterly returns for 2026
Prepared by the controller from the payroll system on January 12, 2027. Not signed.
